trigger.issue: The linked Wikidata entity is a different same-name person; roster construction joined role identity to the AA birth record by normalized name only.

purpose: Audit entity linkage between frozen AA birth records and Wikidata role identities without using any event outcome, chronology, pairability, astrology, Control, or model result.

signals.wikidata_entity_id: fixed QID already used at roster construction
signals.date_of_birth: Wikidata P569 vs frozen AA birth_date
signals.place_of_birth: Wikidata P19 English label vs frozen AA birth_place city token
signals.gender: Wikidata P21 vs frozen AA gender
signals.description: diagnostic only, never used automatically to pass/fail

classification.PASS_EXACT_DOB: At least one day-precision Wikidata P569 exactly equals the frozen AA birth date and gender is not contradictory.
classification.REVIEW_DOB_DISCREPANCY_SAME_PLACE: Exact DOB differs, but normalized birth place matches and gender is consistent. This may reflect a genuine public-vs-AA birth-date discrepancy, so do not auto-delete.
classification.LIKELY_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: Gender contradicts, or day-precision DOB differs and birth place also fails to match.
classification.REVIEW_MISSING_OR_LOW_PRECISION_DOB: Wikidata lacks day-precision DOB; manual identity review is required.
classification.PASS_LEGACY_WAVE_A: Legacy Wave A rows have no Wikidata QID in this expansion and are not reclassified by the automated Wikidata linkage audit.

repair_guardrail: This audit never performs replacement. If repair is required, replacement rules must be frozen in a separate notebook and may not use event outcomes, chronology, pairability, astrology, Control, or already collected Batch 1-3 event results.
